title: Robot Collisions
summary: Given n robots with unique positions, healths, and directions ('L' or 'R'), determine the health of the surviving robots after all possible collisions.
statement: Given n robots with unique positions, healths, and directions ('L' or 'R'), determine the health of the surviving robots after all possible collisions. If no robots survive, return an empty array. If two robots collide, the robot with lower health is removed, and the health of the other robot decreases by one. If both robots have the same health, both are removed. Return the healths of the surviving robots in the original order they were given.
constraints: Robots move at equal speed left or right; only opposing robots collide.
The lower-health robot disappears and the survivor loses one health; equal-health robots both disappear.
Return surviving healths in original input order.
hints: Sort robots by position and stack unmatched right movers.
A left mover can collide only with the nearest surviving right mover on its left.
Resolve and pop until the left mover dies or no opponent remains.
The stack preserves spatial collision order; each resolution exactly applies the health rule, and final filtering restores input order.
editorial: The stack preserves spatial collision order; each resolution exactly applies the health rule, and final filtering restores input order.

tests.explanation: No robots move toward one another, so every health remains in input order.
The opposing pairs resolve according to health until only surviving robots remain.
